objective: M18 Eval Lab + GKP Quality Loop

actions.title: Rerun the non-patch device lifecycle voice row
blockers: No open device_rerun_needed backlog row is present.
actions.command: No device lifecycle rerun is required.
actions.acceptance: The rerun records a fresh hotkey_voice request or fresh overlay audio diagnostics for the device_rerun_needed row; do not edit GKP assets from this action.

actions.title: Review the observational hotkey voice matrix
blockers: Hotkey voice matrix is already closed.
actions.command:
RUN_PLAYBACK=1 CONFIRM_PLAYBACK=1 \
CASE_FILTER=sf2_vigor_ball_observed,golden_sun_ivan_observed,chrono_marle_observed,chrono_atb_observed,ff6_magicite_observed,langrisser_commander_smoke,phantasy_star_tech_skill_smoke \
VOICE=Tingting SAY_RATE=96 PRE_SPEAK_SECONDS=3 POST_CASE_SECONDS=10 \
POLL_ATTEMPTS=40 POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=2 READY_ATTEMPTS=20 READY_INTERVAL_SECONDS=1 STRICT=1 \
./scripts/hotkey_voice_qa_batch.sh
actions.acceptance: A fresh run updates `docs/qa-feedback/hotkey-voice-matrix-report.md`; repeated misses become backlog evidence, not an M18 manual approval gate.

actions.title: Run the final M18 offline quality gate
actions.acceptance: Strict aggregate probes, script tests, release audit, diff check, approved GKP regression, and relevant real-device evidence pass.
